 Patrick 
My guest today is Shyam Sankar, the CTO of Palantir Technologies. I think you'll find by listening to Shyam that the business itself, their mission and how they built it, and indeed him and his life, are completely fascinating. We talk about his entire worldview, which I find personally the most interesting.
